get.description: Staff reads of private data and security events, newest first. Filters combine; `occurred_to` is exclusive. Changes to records are in their history, not here.
A document's details, including whether its malware scan has finished.

A link, valid for one minute, that downloads the document as a file. Only a document whose malware scan found it clean can be downloaded; `409 DOCUMENT_NOT_CLEAN` otherwise. Every download is recorded in the audit log.
Check whether the application is ready to receive requests
Check the database and other services are ready to accept requests
Returns information about the current user

post.description: Starts a draft with the state of qualifying license, which must be live. A PA has one open application at a time: `409 APPLICATION_OPEN` while another is a draft, submitted, or waiting on information. An eligible PA gets `409 ALREADY_ELIGIBLE`: changing the state of qualifying license is not in v1 (Rule 3 §3.6).

patch.description: Saves a wizard step's answers while the application is a draft or waiting on information. `409 INVALID_TRANSITION` otherwise, or when changing the state after submitting.

post.description: Records that you accepted this version of an attestation. `409 ATTESTATIONS_OUT_OF_DATE` when a newer version exists: read it and accept that one.

Sends a draft to the state of qualifying license, or resubmits one waiting on information, in one transaction. Refused with `409 INVALID_TRANSITION`, `409 STATE_NOT_LIVE`, or `409 ATTESTATIONS_OUT_OF_DATE` (the codes to accept are in `details`), and `404` for a document that is not your unattached upload.
Withdraws an application the SQL has received and not decided (Rule 3 §3.7). A draft is never withdrawn: `409 INVALID_TRANSITION`.

get.description: Your license, applications, privileges, and what you can do next.

post.description: Creates a `pending` document and returns a form, valid for five minutes, that uploads exactly `size_bytes` of `content_type` straight to storage. The file is scanned for malware before anyone can download it.

get.description: Documents you uploaded that no application or request holds yet, newest first.
A document's details, including whether its malware scan has finished.

Your profile, as the application shows it.

patch.description: Changes your date of birth, residence address, NCCPA certification number, or other names. Once your state has verified a field it is listed in `verified_fields`, and only the state changes it: `409 VERIFIED_BY_STATE`. Your address stays yours to change.

get.description: The current version of each attestation that applies in every state, in the order to show them.
Every US jurisdiction, by name, with its membership and whether it is live.
